title: Pi Agent
summary: OpenHouse main AI workbench and human-facing web entry.

ai.description: Pi Agent is the primary OpenHouse AI workbench. Its service state is controlled by service-manager through the pi-web service id.
ai.whenUnavailable: First inspect service-manager status and logs for pi-web. If pi-web is running, run openhouse-system check pi-agent to probe the web endpoint and declared paths.
